# SEO Page Creator Agent

> AI SEO page creator agent for Codex, Claude, Gemini CLI, and agent IDEs. Generates research-backed, E-E-A-T-ready SEO page packets, HTML previews, keyword clusters, briefs, outlines, QA reports, and publishable content workflows.

Repository: https://github.com/aiapplications001-art/seo-page-creator-agent
Package: seo-page-creator-agent
CLI: seo-agent
License: Apache-2.0

## What It Does

SEO Page Creator Agent creates structured SEO page packets for guide/blog pages, comparison pages, and product category pages. It is designed for agentic coding tools and AI-assisted content operations that need source-backed, editorially reviewable SEO assets rather than generic AI drafts.

Core outputs include:

- keyword and cluster strategy
- SERP-informed prewriting plans
- page packets in Markdown and JSON
- expanded final copy drafts
- editorial QA reports
- image manifests and image prompts
- local HTML publishing workflows

## Primary Use Cases

- AI SEO page creation
- AEO and GEO content preparation
- SEO landing page generation
- programmatic SEO quality control
- product category page planning
- comparison page planning
- SEO content brief generation
- agent-friendly editorial QA

## Install

```bash
npm install -g seo-page-creator-agent
seo-agent init
```

For local development:

```bash
npm install
npm run build
npm test
npm run dev -- help
```

## Important Files

- `README.md`: public overview, setup, commands, and GitHub visibility metadata
- `AGENTS.md`: short agent-facing repository guide
- `AGENT.md`: detailed workflow contract and hard rules
- `workflows/`: workflow documentation
- `policies/`: data access and image policy rules
- `src/`: TypeScript CLI and library code
- `schemas/`: JSON schemas for generated artifacts
- `tests/`: Node test suite
